probes.note: Downgraded from documented: cloudflare-jvm reverses a surrogate pair into [de00, d83d] and does not change the case of the Deseret letters (deseret-lower [d801, dc00], deseret-upper-of-lower [d801, dc28]), where every other column keeps the pair and maps it. The compareTo page read covers the compare-emoji magnitude lines (jvm family and cloudflare-jvm return the UTF-16 unit difference, the others -1), which promise only a sign. The reversed page is silent on pairs, so that line is unclassified rather than a violation; the lowercase page says Unicode mapping, which the cloudflare-jvm Deseret lines contradict. js-ir matches the native group. cloudflare-wasm prints what wasm prints.
